options.name: apply
options.description: Whether this Dependency should be an applied Dependency.

options.name: apply_target
options.description: The Icinga 2 object type the Dependency should be applied to.

options.name: assign
options.description: List of assign rules to use.

options.name: child_host_name
options.description: The name of the child host object. This is the dependent host.

options.name: child_service_name
options.description: The name of the child's service object. If provided, this service will depend on the parent host or service.

options.name: disable_checks
options.description: Whether to disable checks (i.e., don’t schedule active checks and drop passive results) when this dependency fails.

options.name: disable_notifications
options.description: Whether to disable notifications when this dependency fails.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: ignore
options.description: List of ignore rules to use.

options.name: ignore_soft_states
options.description: Whether to ignore soft states for the reachability calculation.

options.name: imports
options.description: List of imports to make in order to create the Dependency.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Dependency object.

options.name: parent_host_name
options.description: The name of the parent host object. This is the host to depend on.

options.name: parent_service_name
options.description: The name of the parent host's service to depend on. If provided, the child host or service will depend on this parent service.

options.name: period
options.description: Time period object during which this dependency is enabled

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Dependency object.

options.name: states
options.description: A list of state filters when this dependency should be OK. Defaults to [ OK, Warning ] for services and [ Up ] for hosts (within Icinga 2).

options.name: template
options.description: Decides whether a template or an object will be created.
